1.explanation: List.js contains the rendering logic and styled-component layout for each list item, including how the action slot and onOrder controls share space in a flex container. The misalignment stems from the DOM order or flex settings applied here when both props are present. Adjusting the markup and styling in this file will restore the correct right alignment of the action button alongside the ordering icons.
1.bug_scenario: When a List is rendered with both an action (a per-item button) and ordering controls via onOrder, the purple “Click Me” action button no longer right-aligns in its own column. Instead it stretches into the main content area of the list item and sits out of line with the ordering up/down arrows. Without onOrder the action appears correctly at the right edge of each row; with onOrder it is mis-positioned.
